title: 244. Greatest Common Divisor of Strings
hints: The greatest common divisor must be a prefix of both strings, so try every prefix of the shorter string from longest to shortest.
A divisor x of length len divides a string of length L only if L is a multiple of len and the string is x repeated L / len times.
Alternatively, if str1 + str2 != str2 + str1 there is no common divisor; otherwise the answer is the prefix of length gcd(str1.length, str2.length).
